fields.climate: varies from tropical in south to cool temperate in north
fields.hazards: many dormant and some active volcanoes; about 1,500 seismic occurrences (mostly tremors but occasional severe earthquakes) every year; tsunamis; typhoons…
fields.farm: rice, milk, sugar beets, vegetables, eggs, chicken, potatoes, onions, cabbages, pork
fields.exports: cars, integrated circuits, machinery, vehicle parts/accessories, construction vehicles
fields.industries: motor vehicles, electronic equipment, machine tools, steel and nonferrous metals, ships, chemicals, textiles, processed foods

independence.event: current constitution adopted as amendment to Meiji Constitution

fields.legal: civil law system based on German model; also reflects Anglo-American influence and Japanese traditions; Supreme Court reviews legislative acts
fields.military: 18-32 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; no conscription
